title: CLARITY: Contextual Linguistic Adaptation and Accent Retrieval for Dual-Bias Mitigation in Text-to-Speech Generation
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. Its focus is on mitigating linguistic and accent bias in Text-to-Speech (TTS) systems across twelve different accents of English.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its scope is limited to the technical analysis of accent and linguistic bias in text-to-speech generation.
